title: Preference extraction — run 41
summary: Recall recovered after the corpus fix; precision is flat.

cases.name: pref-001 Explicit dietary preference in a long thread
cases.notes:
**Input:** I've been vegetarian since March, please stop suggesting steakhouses.

**Extracted:** diet: vegetarian (since 2026-03) — exact match with the expected value.

cases.name: Negated preference
cases.notes:
Polarity flip. The negation `not ... anymore` is not handled — this is the **known** negation gap.

- expected: schedule: avoid early meetings
- actual: schedule: prefers mornings

cases.name: Ambiguous, judge split
cases.notes: "Coffee after 2pm wrecks me." — expected `caffeine: none after 14:00`, got `caffeine: reduce in afternoon`. Judge split on whether the softer phrasing counts.

cases.name: Timeout on a very long thread
cases.notes: Extractor exceeded the 30s budget on a 412-turn thread.

cases.name: Out-of-scope, correctly skipped
cases.notes: Correctly skipped: the thread contains no preference statements.
